title: Sure Petcare Flap Event Weekly Daily Visits Trend
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder cam detections, plant/soil sensors (`plant:sensor`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and plant sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=surepetcare:flap visits=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(visits) as avg_duration, max(visits) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst daily visits for Sure Petcare flap event events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture visits on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average daily visits with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It scans whether Sure Petcare flap event tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
